audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 with 53.8% owner WR over 1918 games: he out-pokes 1-3 with Overload range and the Flux root chain, Vladimir's sustain overtakes from 4-5 and Realm Warp adds no 1v1 threat at 6. The shape is accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet both say Ryze L1-3 and Vladimir from Levels 4-5 onward — including 2+ items.
audit.why: Content and packet agree exactly, so all seven full sides move alone with rewritten whys per the chart rule.
audit.corrected: phases[0-2].side -> Ryze, phases[3-6].side -> Vladimir, whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste-bleed bullets and no digit in breakdown.cooldowns; the existing text also never states the Flux mechanic that makes his root a root (Rune Prison only roots a Flux-marked target — otherwise it slows).
audit.why: Kit: W 11-9s (root only with Flux, per Riot's text), E 3.5-2.5s, Q 5s but reset by W/E casts, R 180/160/140s utility portal. The 11-9s W window is the concrete number this lane keys on.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns inserted, bleed bullets rewritten (one now carries the Flux-root setup fact).

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Check it before every step-up. - W Sanguine Pool is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Rune Prison (Root) cycles every 11-9s — respect the E-W-Q chain that follows; check it before stepping up. - His E is 3.5s and Q resets off it: poke never rests. - W Sanguine Pool is the lifeline; chip never gets it. The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: Hold W for the Flux root — Rune Prison only roots a Flux-marked target; pooled, his burst window is gone for 11s.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: Charging E burns your health inside his 1000-range Overload poke — at half HP one Flux root chains the full combo.

edits.before: Q-farm and nothing else — your level 1 is among the worst mid. Give CS you can't Q safely and smile about it.
edits.after: His 1000-range Overload pokes you off every last-hit — Q-farm what you can and give CS you can't take safely.

edits.before: Still surviving. Q on cooldown when free, pool saved for the jungler you haven't seen yet.
edits.after: His — Rune Prison sets up trades your heal can't win; Q when free, pool saved for the jungler.

edits.before: E charges join the pattern: Q-E wave contact trades start mattering. Health is your mana — spend like an accountant.
edits.after: His full Q-W-E combo chunks harder than you sustain back — trade only Q-E on wave contact, spend health carefully.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Your Tides of Blood sustain finally outheals his poke — the crimson rush tilts the lane to you.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Realm Warp is utility, not combat power — Hemoplague online means Q-E-R-E with ignite wins the all-in.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: Riftmaker timing — your drain outlasts his mana-limited poke; extended fights donate to your health bar.

edits.before: Late Vlad is a raid boss: pool their engage, R their clump, and drain whatever stayed to argue.
edits.after: Late Vlad is a raid boss — pool his combo, R the clump, and drain whatever stayed to argue.

notes: Content win[] already matched the packet (Ryze L1-3, Vladimir from 4-5), so full sides moved alone with rewritten whys — all seven rows were blanket 'Skill'. Riot's W text confirms the root requires Flux (otherwise it slows); that setup fact now appears in dosFull[1].d. whys[1] says 'Rune Prison root sets up trades' at level 2 without mentioning Flux — mildly imprecise but not false (the W still damages/slows), left alone. No misgendering (Ryze is he/him) and no suspectNames.
